title: Ὑποτύπωσις τῶν ἀστρονομικῶν ὑποθέσεων — Hypotyposis astronomicarum positionum (Outline of Astronomical Hypotheses); RU: Прокл, «Очерк астрономических гипотез»
author: Proclus Diadochus
size: Proem and 7 chapters; est. 25–30k words (Manitius 1909, c. 300 pp. with facing German)
edition: Manitius, Teubner 1909 (Greek and German; repr. 1974), public domain: https://www.wilbourhall.org/pdfs/proclus/ProclusHypotosis.pdf
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia «Прокл» gives no translation; absent from the ΣΧΟΛΗ translation index (2007–2026); no Russian version found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia «Proclus» links only the Greek text (astrologicon.org); de.wikipedia lists only Manitius' German. No English found.
value: Considered antiquity's best introduction to the Almagest (de.wikipedia); Proclus treats epicycles and eccentrics as calculating devices, not physical truths, a key text for 'saving the phenomena', Neoplatonism and Byzantine teaching (a textbook from the 13th c.). For philosophers and historians of science.
ai_feasibility: high-medium: lucid prose; diagrams and parameters must be verified against the Almagest; Manitius' German allows cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Proem, ch. 1 and ch. 7 (critique of the hypotheses), est. 6–8k words
